source: East-coast India to China iron ore is the main backhaul for ships discharging on the east coast; Supramax rates on this lane ran in the high-teens to mid-twenties USD/t in firm markets (S&P Global, 'Firm Supramax rates force East Coast India iron ore, pellet cargoes on Capesizes', 2021). Handysize priced a few dollars above Supramax - estimate
S&P Global 2021 (see Handysize row): Supramax is the main size on this lane - estimate of a mid-market rate
Panamax takes part cargoes of pellets on this lane when Supramax is tight (S&P Global 2021) - estimate
Interpolated between Panamax and Capesize - estimate
Only a few east-coast ports load Capesizes (Paradip's 18 m channel); S&P Global 2021 reports iron ore and pellet cargoes moving onto Capesizes - estimate
Vizag's ore berths export iron ore and pellets (Visakhapatnam Port Authority) - rates as Paradip, estimate
Gangavaram handles iron ore alongside coal (GEM wiki) - rates as Paradip, estimate
Dhamra exports iron ore and pellets from Odisha mines (Adani Ports) - rates as Paradip, estimate
Haldia exports iron ore and pellets on smaller ships (river draft); slower loading - estimate
Gopalpur exports iron ore (Adani Ports) - rates as Paradip, estimate
